# Routing / Command Dispatch

Git is not a web application. Its "routing" is **command dispatch**: the `git`
binary resolves a subcommand name to a built-in handler or an external executable.

## Dispatch Flow

```
git <subcommand> [args]
  └─ common-main.c → git.c (cmd_main)
       ├─ handle_builtin()   → builtin/<subcommand>.c (cmd_<subcommand>)
       ├─ run_argv()         → external git-<subcommand> on $PATH
       └─ execv_dashed_external()
```

## Built-in Commands (selected)

There are approximately **130+ built-in commands** in `builtin/`. Key groups:

| Group | Commands |
|-------|---------|
| **Porcelain** | `add`, `commit`, `push`, `pull`, `clone`, `checkout`, `merge`, `rebase`, `diff`, `log`, `status` |
| **Plumbing (objects)** | `cat-file`, `hash-object`, `write-tree`, `read-tree`, `commit-tree`, `mktag`, `mktree` |
| **Plumbing (refs)** | `update-ref`, `symbolic-ref`, `pack-refs`, `show-ref`, `for-each-ref` |
| **Transport** | `fetch`, `push`, `send-pack`, `receive-pack`, `upload-pack`, `upload-archive` |
| **Index** | `update-index`, `ls-files`, `ls-tree`, `checkout-index` |
| **History** | `rev-list`, `rev-parse`, `name-rev`, `bisect`, `blame`, `log`, `shortlog` |
| **Admin** | `gc`, `repack`, `prune`, `fsck`, `multi-pack-index`, `bundle` |

## Authentication Strategy

Git itself does not perform authentication — it delegates to transport layers:

| Transport | Auth Mechanism |
|-----------|---------------|
| SSH (`git@host:repo`) | SSH key or password via `ssh` binary |
| HTTP/HTTPS | Credential helper system (`credential.helper` config) — delegates to OS keychain, `credential-cache`, or `credential-store` |
| Git protocol (port 9418) | No authentication (read-only) |

Credential helpers: `credential-cache`, `credential-cache--daemon`, `credential-store`
(`builtin/credential-cache.c`, `builtin/credential-store.c`).

## URL / Protocol Handling

| URL scheme | Handler |
|------------|---------|
| `https?://` | `http.c` via libcurl |
| `ssh://` / `git@` | `connect.c` via ssh subprocess |
| `git://` | `connect.c` direct socket (port 9418) |
| `file://` / local path | `connect.c` fork/pipe |

## API Surface

Not applicable — Git is a CLI tool, not an HTTP API server. The `git-http-backend`
CGI script provides a smart HTTP server endpoint for hosting, but this project
is the Git client/core, not a hosting platform.

## Middleware / Hooks

Git hooks (`.git/hooks/`) provide pre/post intercept points:

| Hook | Phase |
|------|-------|
| `pre-commit`, `prepare-commit-msg` | Before commit is finalised |
| `commit-msg` | Validate commit message |
| `post-commit` | After commit completes |
| `pre-push` | Before push is sent |
| `pre-receive`, `update`, `post-receive` | Server-side push hooks |
